title: Concept: Lockfile records a bundled dependency
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry that ships inside another dependency's tarball, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The bundled copy bypasses registry integrity for that package, so the outer package's tarball decides which bytes are installed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The bundled copy bypasses registry integrity for that package, so the outer package's tarball decides which bytes are installed.
